actions.name: Crank It to 11
actions.description: Gain half the mech's tier as an insight bonus to skill checks and double the range for any abilities used via the Voice Projector this round.

description.value:
When activating this component as a standard action, an operator can then make a full round's worth of checks that only require that the target hears them, such as bullying, demoralizing, issuing voice commands, lying, passing secret messages, conversing for a Diplomacy check, and many Envoy Improvisations. Use the mech's space for determining the operator's space.
